highlights.text: Expressed that his goal on the show was complete after showcasing the scope of the gaming industry.
Faced severe backlash for aggressive threats against Arishfa Khan during the captaincy task.
Was forced to apologize by Isha Rikhi over his 'thappad' comment.
Placed in the danger zone alongside Aasif Khan and Rohed Khan.
Nominated by Bigg Boss for rule-breaking along with Aasif and Rohed Khan, but dominated opening voting trends.
Faced backlash following a fierce face-off with Arishfa Khan during the captaincy task after allegedly calling her 'Nachaniya'.
Knocked out of the captaincy race early alongside Yung DSA and cleared the air on his house relationships.
Directly nominated for elimination alongside Aasif Khan and Rohed Khan.
Eliminated from the captaincy race alongside Qazi Touqeer in the first round.
Was called out by Kanika Mann along with Yung DSA during an argument.
Reported to face Salman Khan's reprimand alongside Aasif Khan in Weekend Ka Vaar.
Formed a new alliance group inside the house.
His team called out Gullu online for engaging in self-victimisation.
Gained over 130K followers on Instagram following his entry into the house.
Entered the house as a premier gaming creator, revealing he earns ₹30 Lakh monthly.
Popular gamer and PUBG/BGMI star Tanmay Singh entered the Bigg Boss house.
